description: With a unary old symbol \(h\) interpreted constantly zero on a two-element domain, \(\exists x\,(x\ne h(x))\) and \(\forall x\exists y\,(x=y)\) hold, whereas adjoining \(\forall x\,(x=h(x))\) makes these requirements inconsistent.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.Skolemization.freshness_background_counterexample :
  (∃ x, x ≠ Lemmatheca.Entry.Skolemization.constantFalse x) ∧
    (∀ (x : Bool), ∃ y, x = y) ∧
      ¬((∃ x, x ≠ Lemmatheca.Entry.Skolemization.constantFalse x) ∧
          ∀ (x : Bool), x = Lemmatheca.Entry.Skolemization.constantFalse x)
